story.text: Alice is sitting on the bank beside her {SISTER}, with nothing to do, when a White {RABBIT} with pink eyes runs close by her. “Oh dear! Oh dear! I shall be {LATE}!” it says, and takes a {WATCH} out of its waistcoat {POCKET}. Burning with {CURIOSITY}, Alice {FOLLOWS} it down a large rabbit-hole, never once considering how in the world she is to get out {AGAIN}.
story.caption: Oh dear! I shall be too late!
story.credit: John Tenniel, coloured for The Nursery “Alice”, 1890
